dct_description_sm: ARM analysis files for weed management in muck crops research trials conducted at the Muck Crops Research Station in 2023. Trials included: carrot tolerance to diflufenican; carrot tolerance to acetochlor applied pre or post in muck soils; and control of linuron resistant pigweed with acetochlor, diflufenican and metobromuron applied post emergence in carrots, grown on high organic soils.
